vb_textbox.text: The gnomes come in 2 pairs. I found that the brown or green gnomes initially gave more mushrooms. If the mushroom are 2 or below the change to red or purple gnomes. So if brown is giving lots of mushrooms, also click green gnome in the other pairings. However, if brown or green start to give a low amount of mushrooms then switch to picking the purple and red gnomes.
